sources.title: QuerynAi/queryn-adapter-bge-m3_to_me5-large · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Queryn adapter — bge-m3 → me5-large Translates an embedding produced by bge-m3 into the embedding space of me5-large, so a corpus already embedded with bge-m3 can be served against a me5-large index without re-embedding it. Part of the Queryn embedding-translation engine.

sources.snippet: FastEmbed is a lightweight, fast, Python library built for embedding generation. We support popular text models. Please open a GitHub issue if you want us to add a new model. The default text embedding (TextEmbedding) model is Flag Embedding, presented in the MTEB leaderboard. It supports "query" and "passage" prefixes for the input text. sources.title: BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: New reranker model: release cross-encoder models BAAI/bge-reranker-base and BAAI/bge-reranker-large, which are more powerful than embedding model. We recommend to use/fine-tune them to re-rank top-k documents returned by embedding models.
